claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wide color selection, saying the shades suit many skin tones from fair to dark.
Many reviewers find the blushes well pigmented and good value for the price.
Several reviewers complain that the included brushes are too small to be useful.
Some reviewers note the blushes are smaller than expected or arrived damaged.
A few reviewers mention the texture is powdery or creamy rather than a pure powder blush.
